blocks.text: In the design phase, we plan how the software will look and work. This is like drawing a blueprint before building a house.

items: Create diagrams: show how the parts of the software connect and work together, for example a flowchart of the steps a program takes.
Develop models: represent the software's structure, such as mock-ups of the user interface.
Plan the architecture: decide the overall structure and how the components will interact.
Specify requirements: define clearly what each part must do so that nothing is overlooked.

blocks.text: These steps make the final software well organized, user-friendly and suited to its users' needs. Think of this phase as designing a new house: you need blueprints to show where the rooms and furniture will go before you start building.
